en.headline: AIRSIDE opens Pixar 40th-anniversary exhibition in Kai Tak from today
en.dek: The display runs until 3 January at the Kai Tak mall, with four themed zones, a six-metre Christmas tree and a pop-up store offering limited merchandise.
body: AIRSIDE in Kai Tak opens a Pixar 40th-anniversary exhibition titled Pixar | AIRSIDE Holiday Magic today, running until 3 January 2027.

The organisers said the display features more than 30 Pixar characters and recreates scenes from Monsters, Inc., Toy Story and Up across four themed zones on the second-floor atrium, including interactive light installations. A six-metre Pixar-themed Christmas tree stands on the outdoor plaza, with additional character boards on the sixth-floor sky garden.

A pop-up store opens the same day on the second floor, open daily from 11 am to 9 pm, selling more than 100 limited 40th-anniversary items and over 400 other Pixar products. The main exhibition is open daily from 10 am to 10 pm. A separate holiday playground with games is scheduled for selected dates in December and early January.
The mall said the exhibition marks the 40th anniversary of Pixar Animation Studios and is open to the public as part of the seasonal programme.

zh.headline: 啟德AIRSIDE今起展出Pixar 40周年特展至明年1月
zh.dek: 商場設四大主題區、6米高聖誕樹及期間限定店，展期至2027年1月3日，每日上午10時至晚上10時開放。
body: 啟德AIRSIDE今日起至2027年1月3日舉辦「Pixar | AIRSIDE聖誕奇趣之旅」，慶祝Pixar Animation Studios成立40周年。
主辦方表示，展區集齊超過30個Pixar角色，並在二樓中庭以四大主題區還原《怪獸公司》、《反斗奇兵》及《沖天救兵》經典場景，另設光影互動裝置。地下露天廣場有6米高Pixar主題聖誕樹，六樓空中花園亦有角色立牌。
期間限定店同日在二樓開幕，每日上午11時至晚上9時營業，售賣超過100款40周年限定精品及其他周邊。主展覽每日上午10時至晚上10時開放。另有聖誕遊樂園將於12月及明年1月指定日子開放。
商場指是次展覽為季節節目一部分，歡迎公眾參觀。
